findings.title: Missing optional chaining on `mainHostDestinationCalendar` throws TypeError when `destinationCalendar` is empty or null
findings.body: In `EventManager.create`, `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` leaves `mainHostDestinationCalendar` as `undefined` when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, `undefined`, or `[]`. The very next line accesses `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` without optional chaining (`if (evt.location === MeetLocationType && mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration !== "google_calendar")`), which will throw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'integration')` whenever a Google Meet booking is created for a user or event type without a destinationCalendar.

findings.title: Co-hosts' destination calendars are dropped in collective events when the main organizer has no destination calendar
findings.body: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` is set (lines 1063-1067). At line 1078, `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` uses optional chaining on `null`, which becomes a no-op. As a result, if the primary host/organizer does not have a `destinationCalendar` configured, none of the collective co-hosts' destination calendars in `teamDestinationCalendars` are added to `evt.destinationCalendar`.

findings.title: `calendar.events.patch` receives `calendarId: undefined` when `selectedCalendar` is not found
findings.body: In `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent`, `selectedCalendar` was previously defaulted to `"primary"` at assignment, so both `calendar.events.insert` and the follow-up `calendar.events.patch` (when a `hangoutLink` is generated) received `"primary"`. With this change, `selectedCalendar` can be `undefined` and `|| "primary"` was only added to `calendar.events.insert` (line 154). At line 168, `calendar.events.patch` still passes `calendarId: selectedCalendar`, which will be `undefined` and cause the Google Calendar API patch call to fail when `selectedCalendar` is not set.

findings.title: Fallback lookup in `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` searches for a falsy `externalCalendarId`
findings.body: In `GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent` (lines 254-256) and `deleteEvent` (lines 315-317), the fallback branch of the ternary runs only when `externalCalendarId` is falsy (`""`, `null`, or `undefined`), yet it evaluates `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. Because `externalCalendarId` is falsy in that branch, it looks for a calendar whose `externalId` is `""` / `null` / `undefined` instead of falling back to the event's destination calendar (e.g., `mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId`), so `selectedCalendar` will be `undefined` (`updateEvent` doesn't even fallback to `"primary"`).

findings.title: `organization` relation removed from `loadUsers` query for dynamic bookings
findings.body: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, the `organization: { select: { slug: true } }` selection was removed from the `prisma.user.findMany` query in `loadUsers` when `!eventTypeId` (dynamic group bookings). Elsewhere in `handleNewBooking.ts`, `organizerUser.organization?.slug` is used to build `bookerUrl`, so dynamic bookings for users in an organization will now have `organization` undefined and generate incorrect URLs.

findings.title: Unrelated and inverted `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` slug logic in organization creation
findings.body: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts` (lines 151-153), an unrelated change flips `!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` to `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` when setting `slug`. When billing is enabled, the slug is supposed to be held in `metadata.requestedSlug` until payment completes and only set directly on the team when billing is disabled (`!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED`). With this change, self-hosted / billing-disabled instances no longer get `slug` or `requestedSlug` set at all on organization creation, and billing-enabled instances set both `slug` and `requestedSlug` immediately.
